task: Remove every Hosted Applications UI control that opens a hosted app in a new tab or exposes/copies its standalone URL (card, details header, viewer/preview header, Overview 'Standalone link' field, BUSY_MESSAGE new-tab hint) while keeping in-CodeMie viewing intact (EPMCDME-17135).

key_reasoning.reason: Five production components (HostedApplicationCard, HostedDetailsActions, HostedViewerActions, HostedApplicationViewer, HostedApplicationOverview) plus three to four test suites that assert the removed behaviour (card test, details integration test, embedded-viewer integration test, viewer test mock) give roughly 8-9 modified files across hosted/ and hosted/__tests__/; more if the standalone route, HostedStandaloneLaunch and openHostedLaunchWindow util are also removed.

Several presentation components but all within one feature area and one layer; the edits remove JSX, props (standalone, onOpenSeparately, previewing) and a handler whose only consumers are already listed. No shared utilities change, only usage of DetailsCopyField.

Core AC are clear, but open points remain: whether the standalone route/HostedStandaloneLaunch page and the openHostedLaunchWindow util should be removed or left reachable by URL, the BUSY_MESSAGE rewording, and the ticket's 'Preview (eye) button' wording versus the code label 'View'.

Pure removal; closest pattern is the existing in-app View/Preview path, which stays separate code. Main risk is missing a surface, mitigated by the complete inventory. No security-sensitive surface added and no enumerated edge-case AC requiring new test templates. Agrees with the S calibration example (epmcdme-10102).
